deposit_scan.what_inert_means_here: the fold exclusion removed NOTHING on this deposit, so it is a guard against a column shape that did not occur rather than an active control. Reported because a filter that removes nothing is not a control, and presenting it as one would be the vacuous-control pattern this project has shipped once already
deposit_scan.why_fold_is_excluded: in this deposit `fold` is the authors' published 10-fold cross-validation assignment, not a measurement replicate; treating it as one would manufacture a ceiling from a CV index
deposit_scan.reason: no header matched a per-replicate pattern, so no human reproducibility curve and no human ceiling are derivable from this deposit

bacterial_comparison.model_scale_is: log1p(expn_med) -- the target ridge_gc and the conv are fit against

comparability.why_not_the_raw_row: modal_bin_share uses equal-WIDTH bins and so is NOT scale-invariant. expn_med is a raw ratio on [0, 158.3] with median 0.4338; human activity is log2(RNA/DNA) on about [-3, +7]. Comparing those raw modal-bin shares compares a heavy right skew against an already-logged variable
comparability.note_on_distinct_value_share: a monotone transform preserves distinctness, so that measure is already comparable across the two and log1p does not move it
